commons-bcel: Apache Commons BCEL provides tools for analyzing, creating, and modifying compiled Java class files.
commons-beanutils: Apache Commons BeanUtils simplifies working with Java bean properties through reflection and introspection.
commons-cli: Apache Commons CLI supports defining, parsing, validating, and presenting command line interfaces.
commons-codec: Apache Commons Codec provides binary, text, digest, hexadecimal, and phonetic encoders and decoders.
commons-csv: Apache Commons CSV reads and writes comma-separated data across common CSV formats.
commons-dbcp: Apache Commons DBCP provides database connection pooling for Java applications.
commons-dbutils: Apache Commons DbUtils reduces boilerplate when applications work with JDBC.
commons-exec: Apache Commons Exec reliably launches and manages external processes from the JVM.
commons-fileupload: Apache Commons FileUpload adds multipart file upload handling to servlets and web applications.
commons-imaging: Apache Commons Imaging reads, writes, and inspects image data and metadata in pure Java.
commons-io: Apache Commons IO provides reusable utilities for streams, files, filters, comparators, and byte ordering.
commons-jexl: Apache Commons JEXL adds expression evaluation and scripting capabilities to Java applications and frameworks.
commons-lang: Apache Commons Lang provides widely useful extensions to Java's core language and standard classes.
commons-math: Apache Commons Math provides lightweight numerical, mathematical, and statistical algorithms for common practical problems.
commons-net: Apache Commons Net provides Java clients and utilities for widely used network protocols.
commons-pool: Apache Commons Pool provides reusable infrastructure for creating and managing pools of objects.
commons-text: Apache Commons Text provides algorithms and reusable utilities for processing and manipulating text.
commons-validator: Apache Commons Validator provides reusable building blocks for client-side and server-side data validation.
commons-vfs: Apache Commons VFS provides a unified API for accessing local and remote file systems.
